summary:
Lowe’s is the home-improvement retailer at lowes.com. The blue house mark in the tab is separate from The Home Depot’s icon, and the file here is the one lowes.com returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against lowes.com. HTML came from https://www.lowes.com/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.lowes.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 1150 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.lowes.com/apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #001144 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-180x180-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-180x180-01.png at 180×180 (png, 2275 bytes) from https://www.lowes.com/apple-touch-icon-precomposed.png.
